reason: CryptoIntegration.java:56-71 now sorts by order() and returns the first provider, where it used to throw on multiple providers; other providers are only logged at debugf (:69). DefaultCryptoProvider, WildFlyElytronProvider and FIPS1402Provider all return 200 (patch lines 768-771, 792-795, 808-811), so with two on the classpath the stable sort picks whichever ServiceLoader lists first. The admin-cli example is overstated: ClassLoaderUtil.java:41 builds a classloader with only the FIPS or only the default jars, but non-Quarkus init() callers such as KeycloakApplication are exposed.
